backend/main.mo: Defines types and CRUD functions for products, suppliers, inventory, user profiles, and access control with admin‑restricted mutations and user authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence mappings connecting implemented features to frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for key frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes, theme provider, and guards for admin and billing areas based on user profile and identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access‑denied card with optional login button and navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: React dialog for collecting user info and creating either a customer account or staff profile via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/KiranaBrandHeade: Header component with branding, navigation link, theme toggle, and optional login button.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Button component that switches between light and dark themes using next‑themes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login state, stored identity loading, and login/logout helpers via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, customers, products, suppliers, and inventory using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin panel layout with navigation, mobile menu, header, and routing outlet for admin pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DashboardPage.t: Displays store metrics by fetching products and inventory, computing totals and stock statuses, and rendering summary cards.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryPage.t: Provides inventory management with search, listing, and a dialog to add or update stock entries using product and supplier data.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductsPage.ts: Lists products with search and inventory quantity display, and includes a form dialog to create new product units.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StaffPage.tsx: Shows staff accounts with search and allows adding new staff members through a form dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/SuppliersPage.t: Displays supplier list with search and includes a dialog to add new suppliers.
frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingModePa: Implements POS-style billing with product search, stock validation, quantity updates, discounts, payment method selection, and sale completion logic. Manages bill state and syncs with inventory queries.
Renders customer-facing product catalog with search, category selection UI, hero banner, and inventory-aware product filtering. Integrates identity state and navigation for shopping flow.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters. Supports hash-based routing and safe parameter extraction.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and layout utilities. Enables typography, container queries, and animation plugins with custom theme tokens.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project features, architecture notes, images, and requirements for the grocery system. Tracks versioned feature definitions and overall project state.
